simple.summary: חֲבַיָּה (Chăbayâh) means Chabajah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 61.

definitions.full: H2252. Chabayah חֲבָיָה proper name, masculine head of a priestly family Ezra 2:61 = Neh 7:63 (van d. H. Ezra חֲבַיָּה ; Nehemiah חֳבָיָה , margin חֳבַיָה ; compare Baer's note on Ezra 2:61 ; ᵐ5 Ezra Λαβεια , ᵐ5 L Ωδουια , A Οβαια , ᵐ5 Nehemiah Εβεια , ᵐ5 L Αβια , א Αβεια ). חֳבָיָה חֲבַיָּה, see foregoing. יְחֻבָּה see חֻבָּה below חבב .
definitions.rootNote: or חֲבָיָה lemma חֲבָיה missing vowel, corrected to חֲבָיָה ; from 2247 and 3050 ; Jah has hidden;
